title: Tom Duff Gordon, OpenAI's EMEA policy head, calls on the UK to introduce binding AI rules to "establish durable, mandatory, capability-based requirements" (Joseph Bambridge/Politico)
summary: Joseph Bambridge / Politico: Tom Duff Gordon, OpenAI's EMEA policy head, calls on the UK to introduce binding AI rules to “establish durable, mandatory, capability-based requirements” — OpenAI's top lobbyist in Europe said Prime Minister Andy Burnham should use the current “political window” to legislate for AI safety.
contentText:
Joseph Bambridge / Politico :

Tom Duff Gordon, OpenAI's EMEA policy head, calls on the UK to introduce binding AI rules to “establish durable, mandatory, capability-based requirements”   —  OpenAI's top lobbyist in Europe said Prime Minister Andy Burnham should use the current “political window” to legislate for AI safety.
